acceptanceCriteria: The attempt-runner spec (docs/specs/corvint-tasks-attempt-runner-v0.md) or code states the non-file stdin contract under a cleanup HOLD, or a non-file env.Stdin is gated so the os/exec copy goroutine cannot read it after run returns
The output-gate wording says later child writes are refused (survivors may see EPIPE) rather than that copying stops
body:
## Observation

Independent review of PR #527's race fix (commit f0853500, gatedWriter in internal/tasks/cli/attempt_run.go) passed with LOW findings only. Two of them are follow-ups:

- Under a cleanup HOLD the leader is left unreaped, so cmd.Wait never joins os/exec's stdin copy goroutine. A caller that passes a live non-file env.Stdin and reuses it after run would race with that goroutine. Today cli.go defaults stdin to strings.NewReader("") and the tests pass bytes.NewReader(nil), so it hits EOF at once and there is no race now. This is a latent hazard, not a confirmed bug.
- After shut(), a refused write makes the copy goroutine close the pipe, so group survivors that keep writing get EPIPE or SIGPIPE. The spec sentence says the runner "stops copying"; "refuses later writes" would be more exact.

Version: PR #527 head 6f208e1c. Expected: the stdin contract is documented or gated. Actual: it is undocumented.
